title: Low-dimensional materials for ammonia synthesis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,5021-5080
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00025K, Review Article
Apabrita Mallick, Carmen C. Mayorga-Martinez, Martin Pumera
Low-dimensional materials (LDMs), including 0D, 1D, and 2D nanostructures and their heterostructures, are reviewed for their applications in photocatalytic, electrocatalytic, and photoelectrocatalytic synthesis of value-added ammonia.
